## Static finding at PR #148

Reviewed current head `0fa008998f4b6991bcaec8532012f28100ad75e9` of [PR #148](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/pull/148). This is an exact-source capacity finding plus a dependency-free byte calculation, **not an actual SDK/controller reproduction**.

The [documented design](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/blob/0fa008998f4b6991bcaec8532012f28100ad75e9/docs/proposer-transfer.md) requires 3,062 independent trackers per task and per look for one generation plus audit, and preserves native digest-only replay. Raising the task representation bound to 10,000 does not make that population archivable.

## Exact evidence

- [The fixed power calculation](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/blob/0fa008998f4b6991bcaec8532012f28100ad75e9/proposer-transfer.ts#L67-L76) gives 3,062 trackers with two looks.
- Each task has one target. Both targets therefore require at least 6,124 tasks in meta and 6,124 in audit: **12,248 references**, even with each tracker contributing both targets.
- [archiveTransferCorpus](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/blob/0fa008998f4b6991bcaec8532012f28100ad75e9/proposer-transfer.ts#L130-L138) puts every `{role,digest}` reference, plus the complete manifest, into one corpus record and preflights that record against [MAX_TRACKER_RECORD_BYTES = 1,048,576](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/blob/0fa008998f4b6991bcaec8532012f28100ad75e9/tracker-record.ts#L4-L7).
- The minimum meta/audit references alone encode to **1,132,941 UTF-8 bytes**, already **84,365 bytes over** the limit, before the manifest, development references or enclosing record fields.

A standalone Node calculation of that strict lower bound:

```js
const minimumTrackers = 3062;
const references = ["meta", "audit"].flatMap(role =>
  Array.from({ length: 2 * minimumTrackers }, () => ({
    role, digest: "a".repeat(64)
  }))
);
console.log(references.length);                       // 12248
console.log(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(references))); // 1132941
```

The repeated dummy digest measures fixed-width encoding only; this is not a valid corpus or synthetic transfer-efficacy result. The exact source power function was separately evaluated without dependencies and returned 3,062. No native writes, learner fits or full release suite were run for this finding.

## Expected, actual and impact

Expected: a valid, supported minimum powered corpus can be archived and reconstructed from native records without relaxing record limits.

Actual: the single corpus manifest necessarily exceeds its one-MiB preflight bound at that minimum. Even supplying sufficient independently justified public sources cannot unblock this path. The current powered synthetic control evaluates an in-memory corpus without archiving it, so it does not cover this boundary.

The [corpus-scale follow-up](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rl/blob/0fa008998f4b6991bcaec8532012f28100ad75e9/.agents/pm/tasks/pm-rl-rsipower-corpus-scale.toon) owns source acquisition and independence. This issue isolates the additional storage-format blocker, with PR #148 retaining implementation ownership. It does not challenge the intentionally underpowered diagnostic or claim overspend, promotion or transfer efficacy.

## Acceptance / regression criteria

1. Add a real-SDK regression using a valid minimum powered meta/audit population plus a valid development compartment. Archive, load and digest-only replay must succeed within all existing native record limits.
2. Use bounded digest-addressed manifest/reference chunks or an equivalent bounded representation, retaining immutable history, exact source/split identities, complete integrity checks and compatibility with existing receipts.
3. Cover chunk boundaries and missing, duplicated, reordered, tampered or oversized references without partial success being mistaken for a complete archive.
4. Preserve the one-MiB record cap, existing statistical/resource gates and fail-closed behavior. Do not weaken power thresholds to make the fixture fit.

Duplicate check: all 148 open/closed GitHub issues and PRs, current PR discussion and review threads, and 129 canonical planning/approval/result records. No existing owner of this specific manifest-capacity finding was found; broader source-scale work and the earlier byte-preflight hardening remain separate.
Native transfer manifest cannot fit the minimum powered corpus
